name: Three Bridges
_doc: A 1v1 desert map (P3-23c), its feature the bridges (P3-11): an irrigation canal runs north-south through the middle and three bridges cross it. The middle bridge is the short road between the bases, past a canal village; the north and south bridges are the long flanks. Blow a bridge to close a lane, and repair it with engineers to open it again. Mirrored across x = 128 (terrain_gen.mirror_x makes the heights exact).
_terrain_doc: height.r16 is built from terrain_gen by tools/make_heightmap.py: low dunes, mesas raised above the sand, and the canal carved in four channels; the gaps between them are the bridges' dry crossings, exactly under the decks.
_obstacles_doc: Sandstone mesas and ridges [x_m, y_m, w_m, h_m], west side first, then their mirrors.
_civilian_doc: Canal village and farm houses [x_m, y_m, w_m, h_m, roof_height_m] (P3-05), west side first, then their mirrors.
_bridges_doc: Bridge decks [x_m, y_m, w_m, h_m]: neutral bridges that can be destroyed and repaired (P3-11). Each covers its whole dry crossing.
_neutral_doc: Capturable neutral buildings [building_id, x_m, y_m] (P3-08a), west side first, then mirrors.
_supply_doc: Per side: a safe site by the base, north-west and south-west expansions, and a contested one at the canal village.
